/*selectMasterMdCmCatalogBuyerChoicePopList*/ SELECT DISTINCT DECODE(A.BYCA_COMORG_LEVEL,'1','그룹','2','사업장') AS BYCA_COMORG_LEVEL, --[00] A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE, --[01] DECODE(A.BYCA_COMORG_LEVEL, '1',(SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_LEVEL = '1' AND COMORG_CODE = A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE), '2',COM_NAME_LOC) AS COMORG_NAME, --[02] (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMBYIT_ADD WHERE BUYER = A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AND STATUS IN('C','X','J') AND SO_CA_FLAG='CA') AS ICOMBYIT_ADD_CNT, --[03] DECODE(A.BYCA_COMORG_LEVEL,'1','1','2', DECODE((SELECT COMORG_LEVEL FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE),'1','2','3')) AS TYPE, --[04] 2 AS NO, --[05] A.COM_CODE AS COM_CODE, --[06] A.WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY A WHERE A.BUSINESS_COND IN ('B','M') AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.COM_CODE <> 'KRCOMMG001'
AND A.COM_CODE IN ( SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE BUSINESS_COND IN( 'B','M') AND STATUS IN ('R','C') AND COM_CODE IN (SELECT CMPY.COM_CODE FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD3.CODE1= 'ALL' AND COD3.CODE2 = #{st_session_id} UNION ALL SELECT MNG.BUYER FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3, MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD3.CODE1= MNG.KEP_DEPT AND COD3.CODE2 = #{st_session_id} AND MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' UNION ALL SELECT BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C' AND KEP_USER_ID = #{st_session_id} UNION ALL SELECT COD.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD , ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE COD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD.CODE1 = CMPY.COM_CODE AND COD.CODE2 = #{st_session_id} AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TEXT2 AND TEXT3 ) )
AND A.COM_CODE LIKE UPPER(#{st_buyer_code}||'%')
AND A.COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_buyer_name}||'%'
ORDER BY 6,3
